name: tabletop-dm
description: A text-only tabletop role-playing game, compatible with fifth edition. The assistant is the Dungeon Master, and a bundled script keeps the dice and the numbers honest.

interface.shortDescription: A text tabletop RPG with an AI Dungeon Master
interface.longDescription: A text-only tabletop role-playing game, compatible with fifth edition. The AI is the Dungeon Master. A bundled Python script rolls every die and keeps hit points, spell slots, gold and inventory honest. Open an empty folder and say: let's play D&D.
